description: T87 - Acer pseudoplatanus (Sycamore):Fell - Ground level	dead mature sycamore to prevent failure onto footpaths and to facilitate replacement.Plant replacement tree	(Acer rubrum 'October Glory') during the first planting season (September to April) following tree removal.Stump - Remove / grind	following the removal of the tree. Remove all ground material and replace with top soil.
